protocol.design: 2x2 documents x feedback. Same wardrobe, brief, neutral explicit preferences, generator and planning rules. Feedback is three helpful votes for the target trio. Documents share a nine-note library plus built-in style guides. Rotate condition order by brief; repeat both immediately once.
protocol.outcomes: Target-trio hit@3 = any of the first up to three returned looks contains all three predefined IDs (extra layers/accessories allowed). Count failed/empty attempts as misses. Also record target availability among candidate plans and actual prompt passage exposure; no model judge is used.
protocol.latency: Fresh in-process wardrobe embedding cache for each initial condition, then immediate both repeat using the same cache. Document indexes prebuilt. This is cache-cold/cache-warm local orchestration plus real API time, not Render idle startup or phone latency.
protocol.limits: Six feature-aligned authored cases; one initial generation per condition and six correlated repeats; no user acceptance or causal population estimate. Exact target matching is a preference-recall proxy, not fashion quality.
